scientific_integrity: Population squared sliced Wasserstein costs; the two projected-direction estimators are unbiased for the squared cost. Same-model mathematical review and deterministic checks, not independent validation. Earlier qualitative counterexamples to orthogonal sampling are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Local two-dimensional Gaussian covariance perturbations with non-scalar leading difference; the leading-order boundary and scalar-difference case do not yield a strict finite-perturbation ordering. Exact factor-two attainment is shown for swapped-axis covariance matrices only.
title: A sharp trace–anisotropy phase law for orthogonal Gaussian sliced quadrature
